prompt:
Edit this approved card back precisely. Produce one portrait 1024x1536 image. Keep all eight building types, their general positions, pale dusty sage background, narrow cream border, muted palette and charming flat schematic illustration.
User corrections:
1. REMOVE the large gray Volga sedan in front of the garage cooperative completely. Fill its space with the same plain sage ground and small restrained grass shapes. Keep all existing tiny geometric cars on roads at their current small scale. Keep the open garage's sofa and patterned wall carpet.
2. REDRAW THE ROAD as ONE continuous, clearly traceable CLOSED winding circuit which visits the space beside every building. The road should be a thin uniform ivory line with rounded bends, in the same original Machi Koro graphic language. It travels BETWEEN buildings, never THROUGH them, never vanishes behind a building, never terminates at a garage wall or refinery. Make sufficient clear space around objects for the entire circuit to remain visible. You may subtly nudge small trees or building groups to make room, but preserve the overall composition. No disconnected fragments, no dead ends, no arbitrary little tree-enclosing loops, no forks needed. At the garage, show the main ivory road running continuously in the open ground in FRONT of the row of doors, with both ends visibly continuing around the town; do not send a line into a closed garage. The refinery must have a visible road going around its base with continuity rather than ending against equipment. A continuous route connects the upper district, station, shawarma, garage, mall, broadcast center and church, and returns to its start through clear open margins. Plan this as a closed simple curve around the building groups with inward meanders: no crossing, no building occlusion. Keep existing railway separate from road; train on rails unchanged. Keep mall parking bays but connect them neatly to the circuit.
3. UNIFY STYLE across ALL buildings and small elements. Use the flat graphic shapes and restrained detail of the panel apartment block and mall as the common standard. Simplify the disproportionately realistic church and refinery, and to a lesser extent the station/grandmother, to the same flat geometric paper-cut language: no dimensional metallic shine, detailed hatching, gradients, realistic logs or heavy outlines. Preserve recognizable architecture and requested storytelling details in simplified forms: refinery retains plausible interconnected pipes/platforms and small white Rosneft-emblem flag; worn station retains stylized red РЖД logo, patches of damaged plaster, grandmother on bench and trolley bag; wooden church retains gold onion dome/cross, timber facade hinted by a few straight lines and fence; garage sofa and diamond-pattern rug remain readable. Do not lose these details while flattening.
Keep panel house with its two white tire swans and balcony variety; keep small shawarma spit, pyramid mall and tall TV tower. No new buildings, no repetitions, no added title or writing. Only existing РЖД logo and Rosneft pictogram permitted. Quiet low-saturation card-back palette, consistent detail scale, generous breathing room, subtle paper grain. Do not make the road thicker or brighter than existing. This is a restrained flat card back, not a realistic scenic painting.
